6685.title: Cached plan survives failed usage refresh
6685.rootCauseOneLine: Credential-derived plan metadata remains in the last-good usage snapshot after an error; the panel exposes only a generic machine-level refresh warning.
6685.proposedFix: Separate saved plan metadata from verified paid entitlement; obtain authoritative provider lapse evidence before choosing per-account status semantics.
6685.caveats: Synthetic HTTP 200 to 503 reproduced twice on trusted main. No actual subscription lapse or authoritative billing signal tested. Browser unavailable: no Chrome; actual SSR text is included instead of a screenshot. No safe automatic PR because product/provider contract decisions remain.
